def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # The horizontal divider sits below the colored motif; recolor its top row
    # as a full-width row using the product of the motif and divider colors.
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
    motif_color = next(grid[r][c] for r in range(divider) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] != bg)
    out[ min(r for r in range(divider) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] == motif_color) ] = [motif_color * grid[divider][0]] * len(grid[0])
    return out

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg and r != divider]
    top, bottom = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    # Move the motif until it touches the divider, preserving its shape.
    shift = divider - 1 - bottom if bottom < divider else divider + 1 - top
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = bg
    moved = [(r + shift, c) for r, c in cells]
    for r, c in moved:
        out[r][c] = grid[next(rr for rr, cc in cells if cc == c and rr + shift == r)][c]
    # Mark a full-width row on the side of the motif away from the divider.
    mark_row = min(r for r, c in moved) - 1 if bottom < divider else max(r for r, c in moved) + 1
    out[mark_row] = [8] * w
    return out
'''
